name: Seven Meta-Team Evolution
teamRules: No single global Elo; capability is multidimensional by task family.
Role changes require shadow evidence over multiple comparable tasks.
Weakness history increases independent-review requirements rather than silently lowering gates.
Blind independent analysis precedes synthesis for high-impact ambiguous decisions.
Contradictions should produce discriminating tests instead of majority voting.
Meta-manager cannot change constitution/evaluators or grant itself repository authority.
